patch_description: Instead of returning an empty array, this implementation performs a fast deterministic simulated-annealing search over point configurations inside the equilateral triangle. It computes all C(11,3)=165 triangle areas vectorized via cross products, uses a triangular-lattice warm start (which is known to be a strong configuration for Heilbronn-type problems), and iteratively perturbs single points with a shrinking step size, keeping moves that increase the minimum triangle area. A fixed seed guarantees reproducibility, and a clipped projection handles boundary feasibility, with a graceful fallback to the lattice configuration if anything fails.
